env=dict(vars(typing),threading=threading,time=time,uuid=uuid,datetime=datetime,ABC=ABC,abstractmethod=abstractmethod,dataclass=dataclasses.dataclass,field=dataclasses.field,TskStatus=Status,Gws=Gws,lg=N(**{k:lambda *a,**kw:None for k in ['info','warning','error']}))

out={'cancel_before_execution':{'task_calls':len(calls),'final_status':mgr.getInfo(sn).status.value}};assert calls==['ran'] and mgr.getInfo(sn).status==Status.COMPLETED
mgr._execOnThread(sn);out['completed_task_reexecution']={'task_calls':len(calls),'final_status':mgr.getInfo(sn).status.value};assert len(calls)==2
entered=threading.Event();release=threading.Event();effects=[]
def blocked(report):
 entered.set()
 if not release.wait(5):raise RuntimeError('control timeout')
 effects.append('post_cancel_side_effect');return None,'done'
mgr=M();sn=mgr.regBy(N(name='blocked-owned-control',run=blocked));mgr.run(sn);assert entered.wait(3);worker=mgr.threads[sn]
try:

finally:release.set();worker.join(3)
assert not worker.is_alive();out['cancel_running']['effects_after_release']=effects;out['cancel_running']['final_status']=mgr.getInfo(sn).status.value

findings: Original executor unconditionally sets RUNNING before checking cancellation. Register->cancel->execute runs task and ends COMPLETED, losing pre-execution cancellation.

Original cancellation marks CANCELLED and hasRunning returns false while controlled worker is still alive; releasing worker demonstrates post-cancel side effect. Task-body cooperative cancellation remains necessary; cancel status does not prove work stopped.
Completed executor can run same task again; public run prevents only entries currently in threads, not terminal task status. Direct executor replay reproduced; public run path source inspected.

UI concurrent-task guard checks pending/running statuses only and ignores cancelled-but-live threads; guard can allow new task while cancelled task still executes. Guard registration/start is not protected by manager lock. Source reachability, no browser test.
Manager task/info dictionaries retain completed tasks and result stores indefinitely; only threads entries are removed. No memory bound/cleanup policy in read manager.

tskSvc.stop drops global mgr without joining workers. Cancel checker lambda resolves mutable global mgr, so post-stop checker may dereference None or a different manager. Source observation, not executed.
Task completion callback advances queued nexts without checking completed/failed/cancelled status; cancelled/failed completion can schedule next task by source.

tsk_UpdUI intentionally skips task serial filtering; tsk_OnData accepts completion for message serial without checking current task serial. Stale/interleaved messages can apply other task state. Source observation, no UI runtime.
tsk_OnStatus reads message key type while Gws model uses typ; source mismatch with current model messages.
Tsk.reset does not clear nexts; completed manager tasks and stores can retain pending chain. Session render also resets shared dto photoQ and clamps thMin per render.
